gloss: burned ruins; fire-damaged site; remains of a fire

definitions.gloss: burned ruins; fire-damaged site; remains of a fire
definitions.explanation: The remaining traces or ruins left behind after something has burned down. Often used to refer to areas devastated by fire, including post-war or post-disaster sites.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}け{跡|あと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つめた→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧。
examples.english: I stared at the burned ruins.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{焼|や}け{跡|あと}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{復興|ふっこう}した→復興する：25381_fukkousuru⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧だ。
examples.english: It is a town that rebuilt itself from the burned ruins of the war.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{翌日|よくじつ}→翌日：17960_yokujitsu⟧、{焼|や}け{跡|あと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{焦|こ}げた→焦げる：05344_kogeru⟧⟦{柱|はしら}→柱：05009_hashira⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っていた→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: The day after the fire, only charred pillars remained at the burned site.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{焼|や}ける→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧ (to burn) + ⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧ (trace, mark). Refers to the physical remains of a structure or area destroyed by fire.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {焼|や}け{跡|あと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand at a burned site
- ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{焼|や}け{跡|あと}: war ruins (postwar usage)
- {焼|や}け{跡|あと}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{復興|ふっこう}する→復興する：25381_fukkousuru⟧: to rebuild from the ashes
- {焼|や}け{跡|あと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to clear away the burned remains

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{廃墟|はいきょ}→廃墟：12453_haikyo⟧: ruins — broader; any ruined building, not necessarily from fire
- ⟦{跡地|あとち}→跡地：14281_atochi⟧: former site — site where a building once stood, neutral about cause
